board: Common red "Water Level Sensor" module with an S8050 transistor (3-pin header: S, +, -), as in Elegoo/Arduino starter kits
reason: The check passed on the first run: ESP32 and Pico wiring, design checks, breadboard, the simulator example (S = 1.50 V reads as wet) and the circuit board. S is modelled as the S8050 emitter-follower output voltage, from 0 V dry to about V(+) - 0.7 V (2.6 V at 3.3 V). It is not given in mm, because the real output depends on how conductive the water is.
